# OxyDrop heart-rate voting (FEAT-007)

*Generated by `python/oxydrop_ml/hr_vote_md.py` from the `results/ml/hr_vote_*.csv` files; do not edit by hand. Research prototype, not a medical device.*

Protocol: `python/oxydrop_ml/amendments/AMENDMENT_5_conformal_openox.md` (Part C), the rule below was written down before any result and not tuned. Exploratory: the pre-registered P2 result is the one in `HYBRID.md`. Window = 10 s; reference = the dataset's heart-rate reference; "within 5" is the share of windows within 5 bpm; doubling / halving = estimate 1.8-2.2x / 0.45-0.55x the reference. Intervals are 95 % person bootstraps (people resampled, B = 2000). **Clean** windows pass the shipped v2 quality gate (spectral and autocorrelation agree within 15 %, SQI >= 0.30, ACF >= 0.30); **all** is every window.

## The rule

Three estimates per window: spectral harmonic-sum `s`, autocorrelation `a` (no learned parameter) and the CNN `c` (leave-one-subject-out). (1) Two estimates agree when they differ by at most max(5 bpm, 6 %). (2) If at least two agree, the answer is the mean of the largest agreeing group; ties go to the group that contains `c`. (3) If none agree, every estimate is moved to the octave {x/2, x, 2x} closest to `c` and the vote is repeated; if still nothing agrees the answer is `c`. (4) If the voted value is an octave (2x or 1/2) of `c` and not near `c`, the answer is `c`. (5) Causal median of the last 5 answers of the same recording. Values stay in 40 to 200 bpm. BUT PPG has one window per recording, so step 5 changes nothing there.

Target stated before any result: MAE < 3 bpm and doubling rate < 1% on clean clips.

## Reading, computed from the tables

* **BUT PPG v2.0, clean clips**: voting MAE 10.94 bpm, within 5 bpm 49.2%, doubling 0.00%; CNN alone 8.05 bpm; spectral alone 11.85 bpm; P2 final rule 7.91 bpm. Target (MAE < 3 bpm, doubling < 1 %) not met; paired difference to the CNN -2.89 bpm [-4.50, -1.43], worse.
* **MTHS, clean clips**: voting MAE 5.22 bpm, within 5 bpm 77.4%, doubling 0.00%; CNN alone 6.30 bpm; spectral alone 6.42 bpm; P2 final rule 6.18 bpm. Target (MAE < 3 bpm, doubling < 1 %) not met; paired difference to the CNN +1.08 bpm [+0.09, +2.18], better.
* **Hoffman, clean clips**: voting MAE 0.98 bpm, within 5 bpm 98.2%, doubling 0.00%; CNN alone 2.11 bpm; spectral alone 1.77 bpm. Target (MAE < 3 bpm, doubling < 1 %) met; paired difference to the CNN +1.13 bpm [+0.67, +1.56], better.
* Steps on BUT PPG clean clips (MAE bpm): vote 11.24, + harmonic correction 11.24, + octave check 10.94; the classical estimators are worse than the CNN there (11.85 and 11.95 against 8.05), so a vote that gives them equal weight does not improve on the CNN.
* On the Hoffman phone data the classical estimators are the better ones on clean windows (spectral 1.77, autocorrelation 1.53, CNN 2.11), and the full rule reaches 0.98 bpm. On all windows (clean or not) the rule reaches 4.14 bpm, 4.77 before the causal median of 5, which costs about 8 s of extra latency; the quality gate matters more than the median.

| autocorrelation alone | 27.15 | 12.5% | 50.0% | 73.92 |
| vote only (steps 1-2) | 23.42 | 12.9% | 23.3% | 70.64 |
| vote + harmonic/subharmonic correction (1-3) | 23.46 | 12.9% | 22.9% | 70.68 |
| vote + harmonic + octave check (1-4) | 23.46 | 12.9% | 22.9% | 70.68 |
| full rule: + causal median of 5 (1-5) | 22.83 | 15.8% | 22.0% | 70.06 |

The same person with the spectral and autocorrelation search band widened to 40 bpm (`hr_vote_slow_band.csv`; all 947 windows of this person with t >= 60 s, mean reference 48.24 bpm; the band-51 rows repeat the shipped floor on exactly these windows):

| estimator (band floor) | MAE bpm | within 5 bpm | doubling | mean estimate |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| cnn | 20.98 | 10.5% | 18.7% | 69.22 |
| spec_band51 | 14.31 | 61.7% | 26.9% | 62.31 |
| acf_band51 | 12.14 | 50.0% | 15.4% | 62.04 |
| spec_band40 | 1.88 | 92.9% | 0.0% | 47.43 |
| acf_band40 | 1.84 | 95.5% | 0.0% | 46.65 |
| vote+harmonic+octave (band51) | 20.57 | 17.8% | 18.8% | 68.78 |
| vote+harmonic+octave+median5 (band51) | 19.81 | 19.1% | 17.6% | 68.05 |
| vote+harmonic+octave (band40) | 11.74 | 69.6% | 18.5% | 58.05 |
| vote+harmonic+octave+median5 (band40) | 9.56 | 77.0% | 16.7% | 56.13 |

Widening the band to 40 bpm takes the spectral MAE from 14.31 to 1.88 bpm and within-5 from 61.7% to 92.9%. The CNN does not track this person (MAE 20.98 bpm, mean estimate 69.22), so with the CNN in the vote the full rule only recovers to 9.56 bpm. One person only, and the band floor of the shipped estimator was chosen by cross-fit on BUT PPG; lowering it needs a re-check there before it is shipped.

## Limits

* One window per BUT PPG recording; MTHS reference HR is per recording (a constant for all its windows). Reference HR on Hoffman comes from a pulse oximeter.
* The CNN HR on BUT and MTHS comes from the FEAT-006 leave-one-subject-out runs (recipe P). Spectral and autocorrelation estimates have no learned parameter except the shipped quality gate.
* The rule is fixed and untuned; a vote weighted by estimator quality may do better, which would need its own inner-fold selection.
* Nothing here is tuned to a phone; other phones are untested.

## Reproduce

```
STAGE=hr-vote bash scripts/reproduce_ml.sh     # inputs need the cache (hr_raw_*.npz, shards); `python -m oxydrop_ml.hr_vote inputs|run|slow|report`
```
